assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 225% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising.
Polio cases are peaking in Syria with a cluster of four acute flaccid paralysis cases reported in Deir Ez Zor Governorate.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 1003% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Influenza activity is peaking globally with a 22% increase in test positivity and 55% rise in hospital admissions compared to last month.
Mpox cases in the US are peaking with a 100% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Pertussis cases in the US are rising with a 52% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising with a 1562% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Covid-19 hospital admissions in the US are at baseline with a 13% increase over the past month.
RSV activity is at baseline with a score of 58/100, showing moderate increases in global test positivity and US hospitalizations compared to the previous month.
Norovirus activity is at baseline with a score of 58/100, indicated by increased news coverage but stable Wikipedia readership.
Chikungunya activity is at baseline with a score of 55/100, with a recent outbreak reported in Switzerland and stable US case numbers.
Cholera activity is at baseline with a score of 50/100, showing increased news coverage but low Wikipedia readership.
Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) activity is rising with a score of 47/100, driven by increased news coverage and Wikipedia readership.
Malaria activity is at baseline with a score of 46/100, showing a slight decrease in US cases compared to the same period last year.
Avian influenza (H5N1) activity is at baseline with a score of 44/100, with recent US cases reported and stable news coverage.
